upstream.revisionPolicy: Admission is pinned to the observed Hub revision 05cab0a4; later revisions do not inherit qualification automatically.

materialChanges: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts model storing about 36B parameters and activating about 4B per token, with Mixture-of-Values attention and a 100-expert, 8-experts-per-token configuration reported by the published config.
Native 524,288-token context from midtraining onward; advertised context is not an SZL memory or KV-cache budget.
Ships a custom k2_horizon architecture with custom auto_map and the custom_code tag, requiring trust_remote_code review before any SZL execution; no automatic trust-remote-code.

Chat template implements structured tool calling with tool_call_format json/xml/xml_typed and tool_presentation_format json/xml/markdown, directly relevant to SZL governed tool-call and receipt contracts.
Upstream reports frontier-class agentic and reasoning benchmark results at 4B active parameters; all benchmark claims are UPSTREAM_REPORTED_NOT_SZL_MEASURED.
Open-weights release; intermediate checkpoints, training data and training code are promised but not yet published, so the fully-open claim remains unverified.

acceptance: Pin the exact Hub revision 05cab0a4 and LICENSE bytes before evaluation; the Apache-2.0 declaration does not establish constituent or input rights.
Review the custom k2_horizon modeling and configuration code under trust_remote_code review with no automatic execution; sandbox before any owned-hardware run.
Exercise the declared json/xml/xml_typed tool-call formats against fixed non-secret SZL tool-call fixtures before any routing consideration.
Verify the claimed 4B-active expert routing and 512K context behavior on owned hardware or an approved provider; advertised numbers are UPSTREAM_REPORTED_NOT_SZL_MEASURED.
Exercise failure, cancellation and rollback paths; keep training, model publication, provider routing and automatic promotion false until separate normal controls pass.

deduplication.result: material sparse-MoE agentic model admission: high-leverage candidate for the governed inference and tool-use plane; no serving or routing authority granted
